name: Meereen
description: Greatest of the slave cities, taken by Daenerys in Season 4 and ruled from its Great Pyramid through insurgency, dragon-fire and siege. After the masters' final defeat, Slaver's Bay was renamed the Bay of Dragons.

name: Astapor
description: The Red City of the Good Masters, where the Unsullied were made. Daenerys bought her army here — and paid with a single word: dracarys.

name: Yunkai
description: The Yellow City of the Wise Masters, freed when Daario, Jorah and Grey Worm took its back gate by night. Its freedmen hailed Daenerys as Mhysa — mother.

name: Vaes Dothrak
description: The only city of the Dothraki, beneath the Mother of Mountains — a place where blades may not be drawn. Daenerys ate the stallion's heart here, and years later burned the khals in the temple of the Dosh Khaleen.

name: Qarth
description: Opulent trading city at the edge of the known world, called the greatest city that ever was or will be. Daenerys sought ships here and lost her dragons to the warlocks of the House of the Undying.

name: Volantis
description: Oldest and proudest of the Free Cities at the mouths of the Rhoyne. Tyrion crossed its Long Bridge and heard the red priestess Kinvara's kind preach the dragon queen; Jorah kidnapped him from one of its brothels.

name: Valyria
description: Shattered heart of the Valyrian Freehold, destroyed in a single day by the Doom four centuries past. Jorah and Tyrion rowed through its drowned ruins among the stone men — where Jorah was touched by grayscale.

name: Naath
description: Peaceful island of the butterfly people off Sothoryos — Missandei's homeland, taken from her by slavers as a child. Grey Worm sailed for it after her death, to protect her people as she could not be protected.

name: Lhazarene Village
description: Village of the peaceful lamb men, sacked by Drogo's khalasar in Season 1. Daenerys claimed its godswife Mirri Maz Duur — a mercy repaid with blood magic.

name: Qohor
description: Free City in the great forest, famed for smiths who can rework Valyrian steel. The reforging of Ice into Oathkeeper and Widow's Wail is their craft's echo in the show.

name: New Ghis
description: Island city of the resurgent Ghiscari, kin to the masters of Slaver's Bay. Book background only.

name: Old Ghis
description: Ruin of the ancient Ghiscari Empire, brought down by Valyrian dragons five thousand years before the show. The harpy of Ghis still crowns the slaver cities.

name: Mantarys
description: City on the demon road skirting the Valyrian ruin, whose people are said to be born twisted. Book background only.

name: Elyria
description: Island city on the Gulf of Grief, survivor of the Doom. Book background only.

name: Tolos
description: City of slingers on the Gulf of Grief. Book background only.

name: Ar Noy
description: Rhoynar ruin on the upper Qhoyne, long claimed by Qohor. Book background only.

name: Sar Mell
description: Rhoynar ruin on the river across from Volon Therys. Book background only.

name: Oros
description: Dead city of the Valyrian peninsula, lost in the Doom. Book background only.

name: Ghozai
description: Ghiscari ruin on the Isle of Cedars, drowned by the Doom's tidal waves. Book background only.

name: Velos
description: Ruined port on the Isle of Cedars, swallowed by the waves of the Doom. Book background only.

name: Zamettar
description: Abandoned Ghiscari colony on Sothoryos's northern coast. Book background only.

name: Yeen
description: Cyclopean ruin of oily black stone deep in Sothoryos, older than memory and shunned by all. Book background only.

name: Gogossos
description: Infamous ruin of the Basilisk Isles, once a Valyrian penal colony and slaver den. Book background only.

name: Bhorash
description: Dead Valyrian city on the demon road between Mantarys and Tolos. Book background only.

name: Tyria
description: Lost city of the Valyrian heartland, destroyed in the Doom. Book background only.
